comment: Wired jigs for this project. Mode: warn (reports) → block (refuses) once live violations are cleared. A jig is a fence with a detector. Proposed fences are honored by agents but not yet mechanized — UNJIGGED until wired. mw-gate.sh is always a jig on stock/bench/finished moves. Run commands must work in both shapes: kernel/bin in the Made Well package repo, .madewell/bin once installed.
